source.document: AISC, Companion to the AISC Steel Construction Manual, Volume 1: Design Examples, Version 16.0 (2023), accompanying ANSI/AISC 360-22
source.pages: printed page D-n = PDF page 36+n; E-n = PDF 64+n; F-n = PDF 162+n; G-n = PDF 236+n; H-n = PDF 262+n; A6-n = PDF 510+n; III-n = PDF 940+n
source.content: Only numbers are recorded here: the inputs each example lists and the values it prints. No text, table or figure of the document is reproduced.
source.units: kip, in. (ksi); lengths given in ft and moments given in kip-ft are converted in the tests
source.purpose: Independent review spot-check: worked cases that the design tests of the authors (aisc_design_examples_v16.json, ..._part2.json) do not use. Same single tolerance policy (tests/design_examples/__init__.py).

D.2.title: Single-angle tension member (L4x4x1/2)
notes: An (Spec. B4.3b) and U (Table D3.1) are computed in the example from the connection; they are inputs of the engine.
The example uses rz (least radius of gyration of the angle, about its minor principal axis).

D.3.title: WT-shape tension member (WT6x20)
notes: Yielding strengths are printed as Manual Table 5-3 values.

D.6.title: Double-angle tension member (2L4x4x1/2)
notes: Yielding strengths are printed as Manual Table 5-8 values.

E.4A.title: W-shape compression member in a moment frame (W14x82), column fixed at the base
notes: The example reads Manual Table 4-1a at Lc = 9 ft about the y-axis (rounded up from the equivalent length 8.61 ft and 8.03 ft); the printed strengths belong to that table entry, not to Lcx = 21.0 ft.
No width-to-thickness ratio is listed; the table value contains no slender-element reduction.

E.4B.title: W-shape compression member in a moment frame (W14x82), column pinned at the base
notes: Strengths interpolated in Manual Table 4-1a at the equivalent length 11.5 ft.

F.14.title: Plate girder flexural member (built-up, web 62 x 1/2, flanges 14 x 2)
notes: The web is noncompact: the example uses Section F4, which the engine does not implement; the flexure of this case must be reported notChecked.
Cb is printed for the unbraced segment between the quarter point and midspan with the LRFD loads.

G.8A.title: Built-up girder, shear strength without transverse stiffeners (first step of the example)
notes: Rounded chain in the example: Cv1 = 61.2/106 = 0.577; full precision gives 61.22/105.6 = 0.580 (0.5 % apart).

H.5C.title: Rectangular HSS6x4x1/4: available shear (G4) and flexural (F7) strengths used in the torsion interaction
notes: The example lists neither Sx nor Ix; it shows Lb < Lp, for which the Specification needs neither.
The example cites the Lp equation as Spec. Eq. F7-12; in ANSI/AISC 360-22 as printed it is Eq. F7-10.
The torsion part of the example (H3) is outside the engine's scope.

A-6.5.title: Beam with reverse curvature: Cb of the unbraced segment B-C (10 ft, uniform load w)
notes: The moments are printed as multiples of the uniform load w (kip/ft); with dM/dx' = -w they define the quadratic moment diagram of the segment.

III.MF.DA.title: Part III, moment frame interior column W14x90, Method 1 (direct analysis): Pc, Eq. H1-1a
notes: Section properties of the W14x90 as listed in Example E.1D of the same document (Part III lists only Ag).
Pc and Mcx are printed as Manual Table 6-1 values; no flexural section property of the W14x90 is listed anywhere in the document, so Mcx is taken as printed.

III.MF.ELM.title: Part III, moment frame interior column W14x90, Method 2 (effective length): Pc, Eq. H1-1a
notes: Lc is the equivalent y-axis effective length of the example (Kx L / (rx/ry) = 15.4 ft, 15.3 ft).

III.MF.B2.title: Part III, moment frame interior column W14x90, simplified method (B2 from Manual Table 2-2): Eq. H1-1a
